S2-R2.prd_text: The field sits after Credit Terms | Credit Limit and before Sales Representative (context: field order shared with SV-11638 and SV-10890).

S3-R1.prd_text: The card's expanded section shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer.

S3-R6.prd_text: A new work order or part sale starts billed to the customer's saved default, if any, else the customer itself.

S3-R7.prd_text: Splitting a work order or part sale, or reopening a paid work order onto a new one, copies its Bill To to the new one.

S3-R8.prd_text: New Work Order and New Part Sale show no Bill To.

S3-R9.prd_text: On a Counter Sale work order or part sale, any customer except Counter Sale can be picked as Bill To.

S3-N3.prd_text: Invoiced or holding deposits: see Story 5.

S4-R1.prd_text: The Authorizer list shows "No authorizer", then the customer's authorizer contacts, then the Bill To's.

S4-R2.story_text: Each contact shows its customer's name on a second line.
S4-R2.prd_text: Each contact shows its customer's name on a second line.

S4-R3.prd_text: A contact of the current Bill To can be saved as Authorizer and prints as the authorizer on documents.

S4-R4.prd_text: Changing the Bill To clears an Authorizer who is a contact of the previous Bill To, with no message.

S4-R5.prd_text: Change Customer clears the Authorizer, as today, including a contact of a Bill To that stays.

S4-N1.story_text: When the customer pays for itself, the list is exactly today's, with no second line.
S4-N1.prd_text: When the customer pays for itself, the list is exactly today's, with no second line.

S4-N2.story_text: An Authorizer from the customer stays when the Bill To changes.
S4-N2.prd_text: An Authorizer from the customer stays when the Bill To changes.

S4-N3.prd_text: A contact of any other customer is refused, as today.

S5-R1.prd_text: When Invoiced, the Bill To field is read-only with M4 as its tooltip.

S5-R2.prd_text: Clicking or tapping the Invoiced field shows M4 as an error toast with a "Go To Invoice" button.

S5-R3.prd_text: "Go To Invoice" opens the work order's or part sale's Finance tab; it never reverses anything.

S5-R4.prd_text: While deposits are held on an Open document, the field is read-only with M1 as its tooltip.

S5-R5.story_text: Clicking or tapping that field shows M1 as an error toast with an "Open Deposits" button.
S5-R5.prd_text: Clicking or tapping that field shows M1 as an error toast with an "Open Deposits" button.

S5-R6.prd_text: "Open Deposits" opens the Deposits tab of the customer holding the largest share of the deposits.

S5-R7.prd_text: M1 names the total not reversed and the customer it was taken from, or "[N] customers" when there are several.

S5-R8.prd_text: After the invoice is reversed, or all deposits are reversed, the field unlocks.

S12-R4.prd_text: "Remove As Default Bill To" asks to confirm, in a window titled "Remove as default Bill To" with "Remove" and "Cancel".

S12-R5.story_text: Confirming clears the saved default on every dependent customer; open work orders keep their Bill To.
S12-R5.prd_text: Confirming clears the saved default on every dependent customer; open work orders keep their Bill To.

S12-R6.story_text: The user then deletes the customer again.
S12-R6.prd_text: The user then deletes the customer again.

S12-R7.story_text: A customer that is the Bill To on any work order or part sale cannot be deleted, with today's message "Company with a work order cannot be deleted."
S12-R7.prd_text: A customer that is the Bill To on any work order or part sale cannot be deleted, with today's message "Company with a work order cannot be deleted."

S12-R8.story_text: Today's delete refusals come first; the "Delete Customer" window shows only when being another customer's default is the only reason.
S12-R8.prd_text: Today's delete refusals come first; the "Delete Customer" window shows only when being another customer's default is the only reason.

S12-N1.story_text: Without 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Remove As Default Bill To" is hidden.
S12-N1.prd_text: Without 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Remove As Default Bill To" is hidden.

S13-R1.story_text: Each Bill To change adds a "Bill To changed" entry on the work order or part sale log.
S13-R1.prd_text: Each Bill To change adds a "Bill To changed" entry on the work order or part sale log.

S13-R2.story_text: The entry shows "Bill To" with the old and new customer, each as a link.
S13-R2.prd_text: The entry shows "Bill To" with the old and new customer, each as a link.

S13-R3.story_text: A Change Customer that moves the Bill To other than simply with the customer adds the same entry.
S13-R3.prd_text: A Change Customer that moves the Bill To other than simply with the customer adds the same entry.

S13-N1.story_text: A plain Change Customer on a self-billed document adds only today's customer change entry.
S13-N1.prd_text: A plain Change Customer on a self-billed document adds only today's customer change entry.

S13-N2.story_text: Without 'Customers → View', the names show without links.
S13-N2.prd_text: Without 'Customers → View', the names show without links.

S14-R1.story_text: The tab lists every service work order on the asset at the current location, for every customer, in today's sort.
S14-R1.prd_text: The tab lists every service work order on the asset at the current location, for every customer, in today's sort.

S14-R2.story_text: A "Customer" filter chip sits beside Status, defaulting to "All customers".
S14-R2.prd_text: A "Customer" filter chip sits beside Status, defaulting to "All customers".

S14-R3.story_text: Its options are every customer on the asset's work orders, as customer or Bill To, A to Z.
S14-R3.prd_text: Its options are every customer on the asset's work orders, as customer or Bill To, A to Z.

S14-R4.story_text: The filter is multi-select; a work order matches when a picked customer is its customer or its Bill To.
S14-R4.prd_text: The filter is multi-select; a work order matches when a picked customer is its customer or its Bill To.

S14-R5.story_text: With more than 8 options, the chip offers search ("Search customers").
S14-R5.prd_text: With more than 8 options, the chip offers search ("Search customers").

S14-R6.story_text: A "Bill To" column shows when at least one row bills someone else; it is blank on self-billed rows.
S14-R6.prd_text: A "Bill To" column shows when at least one row bills someone else; it is blank on self-billed rows.

S14-R7.story_text: The Customer filter resets when another asset is opened.
S14-R7.prd_text: The Customer filter resets when another asset is opened.

S14-N1.story_text: When the Status filter includes Imported, the Customer filter is disabled and cleared.
S14-N1.prd_text: When the Status filter includes Imported, the Customer filter is disabled and cleared.

S15-R1.story_text: Internal and No Charge work orders have no Bill To; the field is hidden.
S15-R1.prd_text: Internal and No Charge work orders have no Bill To; the field is hidden.

S15-R2.story_text: Converting to No Charge, or changing to an internal customer, resets the Bill To to the customer.
S15-R2.prd_text: Converting to No Charge, or changing to an internal customer, resets the Bill To to the customer.

S15-R3.story_text: Converting back to billable starts from the customer's saved default, else the customer.
S15-R3.prd_text: Converting back to billable starts from the customer's saved default, else the customer.

S15-R4.story_text: An internal customer is never offered or accepted as a Bill To.
S15-R4.prd_text: An internal customer is never offered or accepted as a Bill To.

S15-R5.story_text: The customer alone decides whether a work order is internal; the Bill To never does.
S15-R5.prd_text: The customer alone decides whether a work order is internal; the Bill To never does.

S15-N1.story_text: Until SV-11665 ships, every work order is billable and these rules have nothing to act on.
S15-N1.prd_text: Until SV-11665 ships, every work order is billable and these rules have nothing to act on.

S16-R1.story_text: The Bill To's portal contacts see the invoice and can pay it.
S16-R1.prd_text: The Bill To's portal contacts see the invoice and can pay it.

S16-R2.story_text: The customer's portal contacts see the invoice read-only, with "Billed to [Bill To]" where Pay would be.
S16-R2.prd_text: The customer's portal contacts see the invoice read-only, with "Billed to [Bill To]" where Pay would be.

S16-R3.story_text: The "invoice created" email goes to the Bill To's portal contacts only.
S16-R3.prd_text: The "invoice created" email goes to the Bill To's portal contacts only.

S16-R4.story_text: Paying several invoices at once includes only invoices the viewer's customer owes.
S16-R4.prd_text: Paying several invoices at once includes only invoices the viewer's customer owes.

S16-R5.story_text: The Bill To's contacts see only invoices that name their customer, not the customer's other jobs or assets.
S16-R5.prd_text: The Bill To's contacts see only invoices that name their customer, not the customer's other jobs or assets.

S16-R6.story_text: A deposit link remembers the Bill To the work order had when staff created it.
S16-R6.prd_text: A deposit link remembers the Bill To the work order had when staff created it.

S16-R7.story_text: If the work order's Bill To has changed since, paying the link is refused with G3 before any card is charged; no deposit is recorded.
S16-R7.prd_text: If the work order's Bill To has changed since, paying the link is refused with G3 before any card is charged; no deposit is recorded.

S16-N1.story_text: When the customer pays for itself, the portal is unchanged.
S16-N1.prd_text: When the customer pays for itself, the portal is unchanged.

S17-R1.story_text: The invoice is sent to QuickBooks with the Bill To as its customer.
S17-R1.prd_text: The invoice is sent to QuickBooks with the Bill To as its customer.

S17-R2.story_text: A customer already linked to a QuickBooks customer always syncs to that one, whatever either is named.
S17-R2.prd_text: A customer already linked to a QuickBooks customer always syncs to that one, whatever either is named.

S17-R3.story_text: A customer with no link is matched to the QuickBooks customer with exactly the same name, and linked to it.
S17-R3.prd_text: A customer with no link is matched to the QuickBooks customer with exactly the same name, and linked to it.

S17-R4.story_text: If that QuickBooks customer is already linked to another ShopView customer, the invoice is not sent and appears on the Unexported report with Q1.
S17-R4.prd_text: If that QuickBooks customer is already linked to another ShopView customer, the invoice is not sent and appears on the Unexported report with Q1.

S17-R5.story_text: Reverse deletes the QuickBooks invoice, and the re-issued invoice is sent as new, as today.
S17-R5.prd_text: Reverse deletes the QuickBooks invoice, and the re-issued invoice is sent as new, as today.

S17-N1.story_text: If QuickBooks is not connected, nothing is sent and invoicing works as without the integration.
S17-N1.prd_text: If QuickBooks is not connected, nothing is sent and invoicing works as without the integration.

S17-N2.story_text: Invoices created before this release are not re-sent.
S17-N2.prd_text: Invoices created before this release are not re-sent.

S18-R1.story_text: The invoice reaches AccountingHub with the Bill To as its customer.
S18-R1.prd_text: The invoice reaches AccountingHub with the Bill To as its customer.

S18-R2.story_text: What AccountingHub receives keeps its current format; no AccountingHub change is needed.
S18-R2.prd_text: What AccountingHub receives keeps its current format; no AccountingHub change is needed.

S18-R3.story_text: AccountingHub AR, aging and balances therefore group by the Bill To.
S18-R3.prd_text: AccountingHub AR, aging and balances therefore group by the Bill To.

S18-R4.story_text: Reverse keeps the reversal record in AccountingHub and the re-issued invoice arrives as a new event, as today.
S18-R4.prd_text: Reverse keeps the reversal record in AccountingHub and the re-issued invoice arrives as a new event, as today.

S18-R5.story_text: Payments, deposits and credits arrive under the Bill To's account.
S18-R5.prd_text: Payments, deposits and credits arrive under the Bill To's account.

S18-N1.story_text: When the customer pays for itself, AccountingHub receives what it receives today.
S18-N1.prd_text: When the customer pays for itself, AccountingHub receives what it receives today.

S19-R1.story_text: IBS uses the Bill To's IBS account: its remit-to, approval and batch.
S19-R1.prd_text: IBS uses the Bill To's IBS account: its remit-to, approval and batch.

S19-R2.story_text: The Bill To's IBS number is saved on the invoice when it is created, blank when the Bill To has none.
S19-R2.prd_text: The Bill To's IBS number is saved on the invoice when it is created, blank when the Bill To has none.

S19-R3.story_text: The remit-to, the "(IBS#: [number])" after the Bill To's name and the IBS batch read the saved number.
S19-R3.prd_text: The remit-to, the "(IBS#: [number])" after the Bill To's name and the IBS batch read the saved number.

S19-R4.story_text: If the Bill To has no IBS account, the invoice does not go through IBS, even if the customer has one.
S19-R4.prd_text: If the Bill To has no IBS account, the invoice does not go through IBS, even if the customer has one.

S19-R5.story_text: In the invoice CSV export, "Customer" is the Bill To and "Terms" is the term saved on the invoice.
S19-R5.prd_text: In the invoice CSV export, "Customer" is the Bill To and "Terms" is the term saved on the invoice.

S19-R6.story_text: The export's last column, "Service Customer", names the customer the work was for when someone else is billed.
S19-R6.prd_text: The export's last column, "Service Customer", names the customer the work was for when someone else is billed.

S19-R7.story_text: The Public API adds the Bill To to work orders and invoices; existing customer fields keep naming the customer.
S19-R7.prd_text: The Public API adds the Bill To to work orders and invoices; existing customer fields keep naming the customer.

S19-R8.story_text: The Public API work order and invoice lists accept an optional Bill To filter; a malformed id returns an error.
S19-R8.prd_text: The Public API work order and invoice lists accept an optional Bill To filter; a malformed id returns an error.

S19-R9.story_text: The Public API changelog announces the addition.
S19-R9.prd_text: The Public API changelog announces the addition.

S19-R10.story_text: Creating an invoice through the Public API for a Bill To on Credit Hold is refused.
S19-R10.prd_text: Creating an invoice through the Public API for a Bill To on Credit Hold is refused.

S19-N1.story_text: "Service Customer" is blank when the invoice bills its own customer.
S19-N1.prd_text: "Service Customer" is blank when the invoice bills its own customer.

S19-N2.story_text: Invoices created before this release export exactly as before.
S19-N2.prd_text: Invoices created before this release export exactly as before.

S19-N3.story_text: The Public API cannot set a Bill To or read a saved default.
S19-N3.prd_text: The Public API cannot set a Bill To or read a saved default.

S19-N4.story_text: A later change to the Bill To's IBS account never changes an existing invoice; invoices created before this release read the current account.
S19-N4.prd_text: A later change to the Bill To's IBS account never changes an existing invoice; invoices created before this release read the current account.
